messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for INC-2026-042 — I pulled the remediation list into a single epic and created initial subtasks so we can track owners/timelines. Epic: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-4829. Please confirm owners, attach any JIRA subtasks, and add ETA.

Priya: Current ask summary (short):
- KV cache eviction guardrails -> owner needed
- Rollback playbook update -> owner needed
- Alert threshold tuning + post-deploy checks -> owner needed
- Telemetry eval for recurring monthly spike -> owner needed

benjamin: I'll take the KV cache eviction guardrails. Will create a subtask under RI-4829 and link. ETA: end of week. @Lina can you pair on verification?

Lina: Ack — I can help with verification and will add a basic smoke test checklist. Tentative verification window: Mon 2026-03-30.

jack: Who should we list as RACI for the cache guardrails? My suggestion: Jack (R), Priya (A), benjamin (C), Lina (I). Thoughts?

benjamin: That RACI works for me. I'll set the ticket roles accordingly when I create the subtask.

sre-bot: Created JIRA RI-4833 (subtask) "KV cache eviction: guardrails + smoke tests" and assigned to benjamin. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-4833

Priya: Thanks — couple of follow-ups: please add the rollback playbook link to each subtask and update the oncall runbook where applicable. Also, let's set a biweekly checkpoint on the epic until we get 3 consecutive successful deploy windows with no recurrence. @benjamin can you add the recurring subtask?

benjamin: Done — added playbook link https://handbook.redwood/infr/playbooks/kv-rollback and created a biweekly recurring checklist subtask under RI-4829.

Lina: One more note: telemetry shows a monthly spike pattern around end-of-month batch jobs. I'll open a separate ticket for a targeted eval (telemetry + synthetic load) so the remediation covers the recurrence vector. Creating RI-4834 now.

jack: If the eval indicates capacity changes, please tag the ticket with 'dedicated-capacity' so infra sched can triage quickly. Also, add expected cost impact estimate if possible.

Priya: Good call. I'll own the coordination with infra for any capacity changes once RI-4834 has initial findings.

Priya: Closing loop for now — please drop a quick emoji when your item is linked in the epic so I can compile the tracker and share a status note by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:

benjamin: :thumbsup:

Lina: :white_check_mark:

jack: :ok_hand:
